name: Discrete Volume Transmittance Integration > Discrete Radiance Step Integration
definition: Computes the outgoing radiance after traversing a small step of length ds through a participating medium with extinction coefficient sigma and emission coefficient q, given incoming radiance I.
summary: Discrete Radiance Step Integration iteratively updates radiance along a single ray using small steps, distinguishing itself by focusing on per-step transport rather than just transmittance calculation.
